```{=html}
<section id="registration" class="wombat-registration">
  <h2 data-anchor-id="registration">Registration</h2>
  
  <div class="banner">
    Registration for WOMBAT are open now!
  </div>
  
  <p class="intro-text">
    Attendance will be limited to 20 participants (in-person and online) for each of the 8 tutorials on Day 1, and 100 participants (in-person only) for Day 2’s workshop. We will also have a rich collection of hex stickers available for all to choose from to decorate your laptop!
  </p>

  <div class="event-cards">
    <!-- Day 1: Tutorials Card -->
    <section id="tutorials" class="event-card">
      <h4 data-anchor-id="tutorials">Tutorials</h4>
      <p>
        The WOMBAT tutorials offerings feature practical, hands-on training in key topics for data analysis by experts in the field. Each tutorial consists of three hours of content with a 30-minute catered tea break, offered in both morning (AM) and afternoon (PM) sessions, and each tutorial is limited to 20 in-person participants.
      </p>
      <a href="https://events.humanitix.com/wombat-2026-day-1-tutorials" data-original-href="https://events.humanitix.com/wombat-2026-day-1-tutorials" class="btn-register">
        Register for Day 1
      </a>
    </section>

    <!-- Day 2: Workshop Card -->
    <section id="workshop" class="event-card">
      <h4 data-anchor-id="workshop">Workshop</h4>
      <p>
        The main day of WOMBAT features a diverse workshop program designed to highlight the latest data analysis tools and techniques. The workshop features a keynote presentation, followed by invited talks from leading data analysts from academia, government, and industry.
      </p>
      <a href="https://events.humanitix.com/wombat-2026-day-2-workshop" data-original-href="https://events.humanitix.com/wombat-2026-day-2-workshop" class="btn-register">

      </a>

  </div>
```
